text:
Sarah - Sales: @Anya Carlos in the POC hit repeated streaming timeouts behind their corporate proxy. Can we swarm?
Mike - DevEx: Seen this with chunked transfer + corp proxies before. Do we have client logs and the SDK versions?
Carlos - Customer: Using our internal Node app -> Redwood TS SDK v1.4.2. Streams hang after ~15s, then client gets a 504 from their proxy. No errors in our app logs besides socket timeouts.
Anya - Eng: Can you paste the raw error and the request headers (redact tokens)? Also is HTTP_PROXY set in their env?
Carlos - Customer: Error: "read ECONNRESET" then "upstream request timeout 504" from corp-gw. Headers: Transfer-Encoding: chunked, Content-Type: application/json, Authorization: REDACTED. We do have HTTP_PROXY set for outbound.
Tim - Support: Two quick hypotheses: 1) proxy buffering kills long-lived chunked streams (common), 2) idle socket timeout on proxy closes connection if no bytes for N seconds.
Sarah - Sales: They want a workaround while we investigate; also curious about any SDK knobs to reduce risk (timeouts/retries).
Mike - DevEx: In TS SDK you can set a per-request `timeout` and control underlying agent options. For node-fetch + https.Agent approach:
```
const agent = new https.Agent({ keepAlive: true, keepAliveMsecs: 10000 });
await client.responses.stream(request, { fetchOptions: { agent, timeout: 30000 } });
```
Setting `keepAlive` helps reuse sockets; `timeout` forces client-side failover faster than proxy TTL.
Anya - Eng: Also try disabling `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` by sending content-length when possible (buffer smaller first chunk) or switching to short-lived non-streaming requests for initial POC. Many corp proxies buffer until full request arrives.
Tim - Support: For Python SDK (if any), set socket timeouts and retry/backoff. Example with requests:
```
import requests
resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=(5, 30))  # (connect, read)
```
And ensure `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY` env vars are unset for the test, or add the target host to `NO_PROXY`.
Carlos - Customer: Can we avoid touching their global env? Their infra team won't allow NO_PROXY changes.
Anya - Eng: Ok, if NO_PROXY can't be set, next options: 1) route through a TLS tunnel (eg, outbound to our dedicated edge with mTLS) so proxy treats traffic as opaque, 2) use shorter responses with prompt slicing, or 3) use a heartbeat chunk (send a tiny whitespace periodically) to keep proxy from idling.
Mike - DevEx: We can also offer a Dedicated POC endpoint in our net-permitted region that uses a different egress path (sales/SDR to arrange). That avoids corp proxy entirely for the trial.
Sarah - Sales: Noted — I'll price the Dedicated POC option and flag procurement. Carlos, would that work as a short-term path?
Carlos - Customer: Yes, procurement prefers not altering proxies. A temporary dedicated endpoint is OK.
Tim - Support: Action items: 1) Eng to prototype heartbeat chunking + client timeout (Anya), 2) DevEx to share TS/Python client config snippets and a dedicated POC route (Mike), 3) Sales to capture cost/contract note (Sarah).
Anya - Eng: I'll test heartbeat approach against an nginx proxy locally and post results in this thread. Quick test command:
```
# curl chunked keepalive example
printf 'POST /stream HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: example.com\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\n\r\n5\r\nhello\r\n0\r\n\r\n' | nc -v proxy.example 8080
```
Mike - DevEx: Also check SDK environment variable `REDWOOD_STREAM_CHUNK_INTERVAL_MS` (internal helper) — set to 2000ms to emit keepalive frames if needed. Not documented externally; will add to troubleshooting guide if this helps.
Sarah - Sales: Carlos can we get a contact in infra to approve ephemeral dedicated endpoint? I'll loop in our ops.
Carlos - Customer: Looping in @infrateam: infra_lead will evaluate. Thanks.
deploy-bot: New dedicated-poc endpoint created in us-west-2 (poc-dedicated-317890). Status: provisioning -> 20%
Tim - Support: If provisioning completes, try connecting SDK with override host header to that endpoint and no proxy env. Example TS override:
```
client.setBaseUrl('https://poc-dedicated-317890.redwood.ai');
```
Sarah - Sales: I'll send a short runbook to Carlos and schedule a run at 11am PT tomorrow. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Mike - DevEx: Follow-up: I'll put the timeout/keepalive snippets into a short GH gist and link here once ready.
Anya - Eng: Quick status: local nginx sim reproduces 30s idle cutoff; heartbeat every 3s keeps the stream alive. Will share exact patch.
Carlos - Customer: Great progress — appreciate the quick swarm.
Sarah - Sales: Closing loop: sales -> procurement, devex -> gist, eng -> heartbeat patch, support -> monitor. We'll reconvene after the Dedicated endpoint test. :rocket:
